alt: ULA Vulcan Centaur rocket on the launch pad at Cape Canaveral during the rollout for its first flight in January 2024, showing the full two-stage rocket and all six solid rocket boosters against a clear sky
story: On November 15, 2026, ULA's Vulcan Centaur rocket failed 10 minutes after liftoff on its 'return to flight' mission — only its 5th ever launch — destroying all 40 Amazon Project Kuiper satellites on board. It was ULA's first total mission failure in 20 years; Amazon, which had booked 38 Vulcan flights for its Starlink competitor, must now rely on SpaceX to launch its anti-SpaceX constellation.
why_funny: The rocket designed to end SpaceX's stranglehold on launches forced Amazon to book more SpaceX flights for its own Starlink competitor — the moment the rivalry was resolved, it was resolved by SpaceX winning by default.
